content.text:
FOMC September 18, 2024 Decision:
- Cut Federal Funds Rate by 50 bps to 4.75%-5.00% target range.
- Dot Plot projection: median expectations of an additional 50 bps in cuts before end of 2024, and 100 bps in 2025.
- 10-Year Treasury Yield: ~3.72%. Money market funds and T-bill yields (~4.8%) will systematically reprice lower.
- Reinvestment risk is active: Cash yields decline as Fed cuts; long-duration bonds offer capital appreciation if yields drop; equity valuations are elevated (S&P 500 forward P/E ~21.5x). Recommended framework: liquidity sleeve in money market/short duration (BIL), fixed income duration lock (3-7y Treasury / BND / bond ladder), and dollar-cost averaging (DCA) into broad market equities (VOO/SPY).
